$comment: Sprint 02 worker-result transport contract (model-owned communication ONLY). Allowed: workUnitId (echoed), workerStatus (strictly WORKER_STATUS), bounded summary, acceptance claims with evidence refs, remaining issues, review risks, uncertainty. Deliberately absent — controller-owned facts that V1 workers wrongly reported (Sprint 03 owns git/test/secret evidence; the controller stamps envelopes): changed-file lists, line counts, patch hashes, base/HEAD SHAs, test-log paths, test exit status, secret-scan results, integration status, controller dispositions, and schemaName/schemaVersion envelope metadata. additionalProperties=false makes every legacy/controller-owned field a SCHEMA_MISMATCH instead of silently accepting it. Never invent missing semantic fields or rewrite types to satisfy this schema; validation only records validity. The payload carries no envelope: the controller stamps records and records schemaVersion.
title: LCIM V2 worker result (model-owned handoff payload)
